purpose: Stress test a change from a dinner-only cap to a whole-order pickup cap. Historical shelf prices plus a published conditional fee; not an order, actual customer saving, empirical distribution or blanket fee rule.
assumptions: Before submission; selected items available and accepted, all subtotal dollars eligible, no other charges/promotions/taxes, no changed weight. No fee at $35+. Extra lines are already needed, not filler. No application of a pre-checkout fee rule to an order that a retailer shorted after submission.
grid: 8 pantry states x 2 fee settings x 4 amounts of other eligible items x 3 whole-order caps. Both modeled policies may stop without removing a package. Cap first, fewest accepted edits next, then lower total; if impossible show cheapest attainable from modeled changes.
